song.title: Let the celebration begin
song.lyrics:
[V1] .F C G Am C/E You've turned it all around .F C G Am C/E Where I was hurting now I'm rejoicing .F C G Am C/E In Your love I'm found and .F C G I have joy Woah
[V2] .F C G Am C/E You took away my pain .F C G Am C/E You turned my mourning into dancing .F C G Am C/E I can smile again 'cause .F C G Am C/E I have joy Woah
[P1] . F Am G Let the celebration begin . F Am G C/E C/E Make a joyful noise unto Him . F Am G Come on everybody . F Am G Let's give Him praise for He is good
[C1] . C C/E F You have given me a joy that ... . Am C/E F won't stop and will never leave, so . C C/E F I will praise You with gladness . Am G F For You are good
[B1] . C F You've turned my sadness into gladness . C G You've turned my sorrow into joy . C F Now I'm singing and I'm dancing . Am G C And I will shout for joy
